correctness_confidence.basis: The half-difference construction realizes indistinguishable pairs from two different corrupted coordinates. Coordinate midranges attain the bound for the maximum norm. The witnesses on page 2 obey the four mean bounds and survive the claimed deletions.

rigor.basis: The proof reduces nonconvex compatibility to finitely many linear support problems, establishes the four-month impossibility and checks all six omissions. Rational crossings suffice, including the ratio one third.

novelty.basis: Sparse-error correction, temporal disaggregation and bounded-error optimal recovery are established. The exact constants and equality of all one-omission designs are plausible design-specific contributions. Priority across all moving-average designs has not been established.

significance.basis: The constants quantify the value of saving the sixth observation and its dependence on relative precision. No ecological effect or monthly sensor uncertainty is estimated.

reproducibility.basis: Two separate fetches produced byte-identical PDFs. The verifier enumerates survivor designs, recomputes the symbolic branches and checks explicit lower witnesses at several ratios against a primal linear program.

summary: The three-page manuscript determines the exact worst reconstruction error for six monthly values measured via four overlapping averages, with one arbitrary monthly fault. The distinction between seasonal p-values and measurements of levels is explicit. I inspected the three rendered pages, the source study and the rational certificate. I contributed to drafting and verification in the same context.
strengths: Relates the estimable monthly contrasts to the two-dimensional nullspace.
The precision-dependent formulas give an exact decision rule for an additional measurement.
Explicitly locates the data required beyond the ecological publication.
weaknesses: A short human-checkable dual certificate for each branch would make the precise constants easier to audit without the supplement.
Equal within-season weighting and deterministic uniform envelopes need justification for a field application.
The ecological example supplies the sampling geometry and significance map, without sample-specific monthly reconstruction.
potential_errors: Identifiability across the four spring windows cannot be transferred directly to all other seasons or to unequal event-year weights.
Coordinate midpoint recovery can return a vector outside the feasible set. The minimax claim would need reconsideration if the estimator were required to return a compatible signal.
strong_novelty_candidates: The design-specific sharp expressions 9s+2d and max(3s+2d,6s+d), including invariance under any single omitted month.
